[0] Max: I cross the guild hall to the quest counter and put both hands flat on the wood. "Tobias. The Wendhope posting. Tell me what it actually pays and who has already turned it down."

*He taps the board with a finger, his voice lowering slightly.*
"The quest has been sitting there for two weeks. Several C-rank parties tried it and... well, we don't know what happened. They never returned. The last party to attempt it was three days ago. "Please, consider other quests. There are many other D-rank quests on the board, some of which as we- "
*His voice trails off, as he looks at you with those ocean-blue eyes.*
"I-I-I insist on that you do not take the quest. It would be be be a very foolish mistake."
